response.sql: WITH matched_pairs AS (SELECT r.ordervault, o.recordvault, o.timespan FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault), bucket_counts AS (SELECT COALESCE(timespan, 'NO_TIMESPAN') AS bucket, COUNT(DISTINCT recordvault) AS order_count FROM matched_pairs GROUP BY COALESCE(timespan, 'NO_TIMESPAN')), bucket_stats AS (SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_count, COUNT(*) AS num_buckets FROM bucket_counts), with_shares AS (SELECT bc.bucket, bc.order_count, CAST(bc.order_count AS NUMERIC) / CAST(bs.total_count AS NUMERIC) AS share, CAST(1 AS NUMERIC) / CAST(bs.num_buckets AS NUMERIC) AS avg_share FROM bucket_counts bc CROSS JOIN bucket_stats bs), filtered_buckets AS (SELECT bucket, order_count, share, avg_share FROM with_shares WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS avg_share_of_kept, AVG(share - avg_share) AS avg_excess FROM filtered_buckets
